create_markuplm_config: create a MarkupLMConfig instance with default transformer configuration parameters
build_markuplm_model: build a MarkupLMModel from a MarkupLMConfig configuration object
customize_markuplm_config: customize MarkupLMConfig hyperparameters like vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
access_model_config: access the MarkupLMConfig from an existing MarkupLMModel instance via model.config
configure_xpath_embeddings: configure MarkupLMConfig with xpath tag and subscript embedding parameters for document layout analysis
